svg.title: Noctiluca brand asset pipeline
svg.desc: One vector definition of the glowing cell mark is rendered into the favicon, Apple touch icon, 192 and 512 icons, a maskable icon and thirteen iOS splash screens.
svg.text: A glowing cell, its two orbit rings and
a small constellation, rendered by sharp
From 640 × 1136 to 1320 × 2868, wired up with apple-touch-startup-image media queries in index.html.
The boot screen paints the abyss immediately, so there is never a white flash before CSS loads.
